title: Julius Evola stayed with the SS to the end of the war

tellings.quote: No, he stayed with the SS till the end of the war. >> Oh interesting. He had access to their libraries and they let him have it.

plain: According to the writer Peter Levenda, a man named Julius Evola stayed with the SS, Nazi Germany's elite force, until the end of the Second World War. Levenda says the SS gave Evola access to its libraries and let him use them. Levenda tells this to Michels without naming a source, as a sign of how close Evola was to the Nazi inner circle.
